Title: Cruisin' for a Bruisin/Road Trippin'
Writer: Douglas Segal, Robert Zappia, Jim Praytor
Plot: Rick and Ginger's vacation cruise ship, to make sure Tom and Spike don't cause havoc, they keep them in the carriers. Rick and Ginger go on a road trip to visit Ginger's great aunt Claire, but on the trip, Spike and Tom get lost.
